name: LUXX Creator 001 — 28 day hold sheet
creator: LUXX001
built_on: Her live baselines only. Not the app default week.
locked_rules: Cam Wednesday and Friday only, 10:00-13:00 CT. Eight lives in 28 days.
X and Pornhub traffic goes to OnlyFans Free only. OF Paid, ManyVids and Chaturbate stay native. Fansly stays off.
No face on X or Pornhub unless a face-safe file already exists. If it does not, skip the upload.
Do not wait on LUXX teasers. Post vault files.
PPV stays $10 until the Sunday numbers say otherwise. Week 4 best-of is $12.
If a day slips, move it to the next non-cam day. Never stack a missed cam onto Friday.
X is three posts a week — Tuesday, Thursday, Saturday. Twelve in 28 days, never seven a week.
The sheet sets the price. PPV is $10 all month; the week 4 best-of is $12. The creator never chooses a price.
Pornhub uses two different codes: c7 in the Official Website field, c10 in video descriptions. One code, one placement.
